limitations: The published demonstration uses a 2-D latent score-dynamics task; it does not establish general high-resolution image-generation capability.
The VAE encoder and decoder are outside the analog latent-dynamics macro.
Reported fully integrated latency and energy values include projected or analytical estimates; this profile does not treat them as measured full-system capability.
Literature-reported profile only. No Luminous physical hardware is identified or qualified.
Noise spectrum, autocorrelation, cross-channel covariance, fault topology and operating envelope remain unknown in this profile.
The paper's physical demonstration, projected integrated-system figures and analytical energy estimates are separate evidence classes.
